component.name: Tautulli
component.summary: Monitor and track your Plex Media Server

description.p: Tautulli runs next to your Plex Media Server. It shows what was watched, who watched it, when, where, and how. The web interface presents these statistics in tables and graphs.
Tautulli starts a local web server on port 8181 and opens it in your browser. Run it with --nolaunch to start the server without opening a browser.

ul.li: Current activity on your Plex Media Server
Watch history and statistics for users, libraries, and media
Notifications for playback and server events
Newsletters with recently added media
Fix: Snap package not starting.
Support for Python 3.10 has been dropped. The minimum Python version is now 3.11.

Installs without a password set will generate a temporary random password on upgrade. The temporary login info can be found in the Tautulli log file. Please change the password in the settings after logging in.
